queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'SUHelper %' AND publisher = 'Lenovo';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'SUHelper %' AND publisher = 'Lenovo' AND version_compare(version, '1.0.0.22') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'lenovo suhelper.exe');
